summary: Defines a profile of Static Context Header Compression and Fragmentation (SCHC, RFC 8724) for LoRaWAN. It shows how to apply SCHC's generic compression and fragmentation to this low-power wide-area technology, whose messages are very small.

eli5.summary: LoRaWAN messages are tiny. This shows how to shrink Internet headers and slice larger messages so they still fit.

questions: how to send ipv6 over lorawan
